Fan review ('Awful Railing, Good Legroom'): 'After sitting in the front row of Section 338, I decided I would never sit in the front row of Citi Field's 300 level again. The railing blocks a good portion of the outfield when sitting normally in the seats... It was near impossible to see anything up against the left field wall below, and that continued from the left field foul pole to deep center. The one redemption for these seats was the nice amount of legroom.' (Sec 338 / Row 1)

zone: The Porch (also called 'Left Field Landing' per this page's Q&A)
location: "The Porch is made up of Sections 334–339 in left field at Citi Field." "These sections are located above and slightly behind the Outfield Reserved seating, giving fans a higher vantage point over the left-field corner." Q&A on this page: 'The Left Field Landing sections are where fans can buy Family Pack tickets... The Left Field Landing consists of Sections 334-339, which are also located close to the Fan Fest Family Area on the concourse level behind Center Field.'
seat_direction: When looking towards the field/stage, lower number seats are on the left
notes: Section Insights for this section list only 'Rows 1-14' and 'Behind/Side Stage (most shows)' — unlike sibling sections 334-338, this page does NOT include a 'Top Pick' or 'Rows X & Above - Covered' bullet, consistent with the fan review below. 'For Concerts, Section 339 May Have a Limited View.' Fan review ('Terribly Sunny and No Scoreboard Views'): 'The roof of the 500 level provides excellent cover and shade for all the 300 level sections in left field, except for Section 339! I was in the sun for the entire day, while the seats just to my right in Section 338 looked ridiculously comfortable in the shade. Its impossible to see the center field videoboard, and don't expect to follow anything up against the left field wall. ... There is only one stairway and one elevator to get to these sections from the field level, so it feels much less crowded and restroom lines were very short.' (Sec 339 / Row 13)
